_doc: What has been tried in Emkay (OVOS in the browser). status: works | broken | untested; reason: why (shown in the store). Entries with `tested` (and `version`) are written by the nightly test (tools/test_skills.mjs, workflow test-skills.yml) and retried on a new version or after 30 days. Entries without `tested` are written by hand, for what the test cannot see, and are never retried. Skills Emkay ships come from app.emkay.ai/build.json and need no entry.
